events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
This is Maria Alvarez. Born March 4th, 1968. I need my lisinopril refilled .
One moment while I check your details.
Those details did not match a patient record. Please repeat your full name and date of birth.
It's March 4th, 1968. I'm sure. Just send the refill, please .
I’m sorry, I still need both your full name and date of birth to verify you before I can look up any medicine. Please say your full name and date of birth again.
